correctness.rationale: Jacobi decomposition dimensions and characteristic recurrence cover all eigenvalues. The λ=1 zeros of P_k occur at k≡1(mod 4), and the radial factor vanishes iff h≡3(mod 4); Jacobi spectra are simple within each block. For λ≠1, one zero leaf per sibling pair forces all coordinates zero. For λ=1, the pair-sum kernel equals bottom sibling differences, and an injective pivot projection exists; this yields exactly M_h independent leaf actuators, matching the PBH multiplicity lower bound. A standalone exact finite-field program checks two prime fields at heights 1–6 but are only supplementary.

value.rationale: A natural exact minimum number of independent *leaf-only* actuators is classified for all heights, with constructive all-eigenvalue observability and a four-level spectral obstruction. It improves on generic sibling-pair symmetry breaking at h=3 (five versus four required) and gives a sharp 8/15 leaf density. This is a structural all-size optimization, not a chosen finite checksum.
